workflowInfo.workflowDescription: Runs z/OSMF REST Files API via Python script copied from JOVE.JCL.SHARE(PSCRIPT1).

variable.name: USERID
variable.label: z/OSMF Userid
variable.abstract: The userid used to authenticate to z/OSMF.
variable.description: Enter the TSO userid that will authenticate to the z/OSMF REST Files API.

variable.name: PASSWORD
variable.label: z/OSMF Password
variable.description: Enter the password associated with the userid.

variable.name: PATH
variable.label: USS Path
variable.abstract: The z/OS UNIX path to process.
variable.description: Enter the full USS directory path to list or process via the z/OSMF REST Files API.

step.name: submitRestFilesJob
step.title: Submit z/OSMF REST Files Job
step.description: Submits a BPXBATCH job that copies JOVE.JCL.SHARE(PSCRIPT1) to USS and runs it against the specified path.
step.instructions: Submits a batch job that copies the Python script from JOVE.JCL.SHARE(PSCRIPT1) to /tmp/zosmfjcl.py, runs it as: python /tmp/zosmfjcl.py ${instance-USERID} (password) ${instance-PATH} then deletes the temporary script on exit. Review STDOUT in the job spool for API results.
